description.value: New Brighton Pool is a seasonal outdoor public swimming pool operated by the City of Vancouver, situated near the waterfront in the Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood of East Vancouver. It is open during summer months and is one of several outdoor pools the city operates for public recreation. Touring cyclists riding the nearby Central Valley Greenway or exploring the East Vancouver waterfront will find it a convenient stop on a warm summer day.

address.value: 3201 New Brighton Rd, Vancouver, BC V5K 5J1, Canada
